summary: The agent successfully implements a cross-validated ensemble of gradient boosting regressors with optimized blending weights. However, it fails to implement an explicit missing value strategy for numerical columns, relying entirely on the models' native handling. More critically, the agent hardcodes the submission IDs with a generic zero-based sequence rather than extracting the true IDs from the test set, which will almost certainly cause the submission file to be rejected or scored incorrectly.
